data.text/markdown:
Jaw FEM - gmsh + CalculiX

Right jaw, EN AW-7075 T6. The holder face takes the grip force (normal direction only), the two dowels locate it; the grip force acts as uniform pressure on the pad pocket floor. Pick a load case and a mesh size, then press Run. One run takes a few seconds at 2.5 mm and about a minute at 1 mm.
Press Run to compute.
